target.name: target_fills_export.json.gz
target.selection: exact union of four frozen protocol market lists, with recorded BTC fills
target.event_ms_definition: API executedAt converted to Unix milliseconds; all exported values have one-second resolution
target.observed_at_ms_definition: stored local observation timestamp in Unix milliseconds; distinct from execution time
target.price_definition: stored price for the row's UP/DOWN outcome; all exported quote_type values are BID; no complement conversion applied
target.settlement_definition: recorded filled cashflow plus winner payout, without explicit fees; market-level value repeated per fill, not complete private account PnL

target.name: target_lifecycle_features.json.gz

selection.rule: complete L2 book coverage with existing 5000-ms start/tail/gap tolerance and initial full checkpoint; market_id DESC, limit150; no PnL/winner/confidence selection

target.book_axis: original source timestamps; no clock adjustment; last update <= query including equality
target.received_variants: four *_recv price fields use receive-ordered book replay and last received timestamp <= the same stored lifecycle query time; no clock adjustment
target.range_rule: placement/fill use the last known update <= query; no update before query gives null; plus5s additionally gives null outside first/last book timestamps
target.price_rule: parent target_price unchanged; UP best bid/native mid; DOWN 1-native best ask and 1-native mid
target.timestamps: Unix milliseconds; observed target event timestamps have second resolution; millisecond storage does not prove millisecond inference accuracy
target.anonymity: anon_seq is a fresh sequential number; no original parent/order/leg/account identifiers or evidence_json exported
target.observation_boundary: filled_qty and first_target_ms come from matched observed target fills; placement_first_ms/resting_ms and post_action are anonymous-book inferences; confidence is heuristic; V2.1 parent universe requires observed matched fills and omits unfilled orders
target.placement_caveat: placement can occur after observed first_target_ms because inference anchors on a matched public update; inclusive placement best quote can contain the inferred added depth
target.future_field: plus5s mid is an explicitly offline later observation, not a decision-time input
